::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Greater Noida analog/mixed-signal firm founded 2017 (about 45 engineers, Feb 2025) with 110+ analog IP blocks. Among the earliest DLI approvals (2023); its motor-control and metering ICs were at sampling stage in 2025–26.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Analog and mixed-signal ICs and IP: motor-control MCUs, analog front-ends, data converters and smart-metering ASICs.

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 3/5:** Analog and mixed-signal motor-control MCUs, analog front-ends and data converters.
- **IP ownership 4/5:** Own portfolio of 110+ analog IP blocks.
- **Design completeness 4/5:** ICs at sampling stage in 2025-26 implies working silicon; no tape-out dates published.
- **Market readiness 3/5:** Motor-control and metering ICs described as at sampling stage in 2025-26.
